basic_profile.bio: A 24-year-old from South Jersey, I'm just starting to explore the vast world of Reddit. I work part-time at a local comic book store and am a huge fan of anime and manga, which fuels my frequent visits to GoodSmileCompany. In my free time, I love watching college football, especially the Pac-12 games, and I'm trying to learn more about tech setups like bspwm. I'm currently single and enjoying the freedom to explore my interests. Usually online during late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Mostly self-taught through online forums and YouTube channels. My job at the comic book store has also helped me pick up a lot about pop culture and current trends. I have a decent grasp of anime collectibles and have started diving into tech customization.
